title: ranunculus sceleratus var. typicus
intro: Ranunculus sceleratus var. typicus, commonly known as the common celandine or lesser celandine, is a flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including its ability to treat liver and gallbladder issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus sceleratus var. typicus include its ability to stimulate liver function, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
